name: Mary Anta
source: Since the rumors spread of a serial killer in her city, her parents sent her to live with her aunt, uncle and cousin in a cabin out of town. Likes cemeteries and funerals because she believes it shows the love of the deceased's family and friends, and believes their spirits still linger. Because of her strange habit, she was bullied as a child and later homeschooled. Despite this, she's an extroverted and kind girl.
